label: National Pension: minimum contribution period for an old-age pension
appliesTo: Anyone contributing to the National Pension, including foreign nationals
why: Decides whether years of contributions become a pension or a question about a refund, which for a foreign employee is the whole planning problem. Someone leaving after six years has no old-age pension entitlement, and whether they get anything back is a separate test on nationality and status rather than on how much they paid in.

history.note: An old-age pension in the form of a pension generally requires at least ten years of coverage. Below that the money does not vanish, but it is dealt with through the refund rules, which turn on reciprocity, a social security agreement or a specified status of stay — not on the length of contribution.
